%FEATURE_STRUCTURES.sofaString: Department: Haematology GroupDate of registration: 20/04/2022A 69-year-old patient with a medical history of arterial hypertension and cholecystectomy. On 26 March 2022, the patient developed fatigue, anorexia and a febrile syndrome. Consequently, on 12 April 2022, a full blood count was performed, revealing leukocytosis, anaemia and thrombocytopenia. On 20 April 2022, the patient was diagnosed with acute myeloid leukaemia with a normal karyotype and intermediate risk. It was decided to propose induction chemotherapy with mitoxantrone and cytarabine, followed by consolidation therapy with cytarabine.
